source_instruction: i'm looking for a high performance hdmi to displayport adapter cable that's easy to use.
query: I spent my whole walk over here replaying that last round of my neighborhood cornhole league in my head, can you believe I missed that last toss by three whole inches because a squirrel darted across the board? I stopped on the way for a blue raspberry slushie that gave me immediate brain freeze so bad I had to sit on a curb for two minutes, and I’m still low-key mad the corner bodega was all out of the spicy pickle chips I’ve been craving all week. Since you probably don’t have any high performance HDMI cables in stock right now, just show me easy to use options that are $40 or less, yeah?
